profile.name: Pulsar任意波形发生器协调控制器
profile.description: 一个非物理的软件组件，用于在实验中统一管理、配置和编程一台或多台任意波形发生器（AWG）。它维护通道定义、查询时钟、协调主从AWG启动，并将序列与波形元素下发到受支持的AWG，证据显示其主要面向 Tektronix AWG5014，并部分支持 Zurich Instruments UHFLI。
profile.description_en: A non-physical software component for centrally managing, configuring, and programming one or more arbitrary waveform generators (AWGs) in experiments. It keeps channel definitions, queries clock rates, coordinates master/slave AWG startup, and uploads sequences and waveform elements to supported AWGs. The evidence indicates primary support for the Tektronix AWG5014 and partial support for the Zurich Instruments UHFLI.

registry.name: QuTech Pulsar Pulse Generation
registry.description: QuTech Pulsar Pulse Generation Module是由QuTech生产的表征设备，主要功能包括停止、启动。支持AWG obj, Signal, Slot等操作。
